prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Sync Status & Pet Recovery Clarity: Redesign sign-in layout into a split screen highlighting cloud pet save status and account persistence details.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Companion Safe", "body": "Your pet, memories, and desktop settings automatically save to your account so you never lose them."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Preview Flow: Add interactive pet preview components during friend selection to let users test animations and appearance before finalizing.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Preview Pet Animations", "style": "highlight", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Check Screen: Introduce a new onboarding screen step 'new_desktop_check' after waiting to verify that the pet appears correctly on the desktop background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"]}}
3: [finish, redesign] Interactive Pet Control Checklist: Redesign the final welcome screen into a checklist tutorial teaching users how to hide, summon, and talk to their desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "How to Control & Chat With Your New Pet", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop to hide, summon, or open conversation controls."}}
4: [choose_path, reorder] Defer Account Creation Until Adoption: Move the sign_in step after pet adoption steps so users customize their pet before being asked to sign in.
   config: {"choose_path": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity & Quality Hints: Display explicit photo upload guidance and format hints to prevent upload failures and bad custom renders.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit photos for accurate pet generation. Avoid blurry or dark images.", "show_step_counter": true}}
6: [home, wait_info] Setup Progress & Desktop Tips Carousel: Show dynamic setup progress updates and a pet tip carousel while the pet assets download and prepare.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet to your mouse position.", "style": "calm"}]}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Structured Path Grid Comparison: Switch path selection to a structured grid layout clearly comparing preset adoptable pets vs custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to generate a unique pet."}}
8: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Stalling Recovery Helper: Add a fallback notification hint offering alternative sign-in options if the screen stalls or takes long to load.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Having trouble signing in? Check your connection or click below to retry OAuth load.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [finish, incentive] Starter Pack Reward Badge: Display a completion reward badge for a free starter pet toy on the home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Home! You Unlocked a Starter Pet Toy", "body": "Your companion is live on your desktop. Enjoy your exclusive starter toy pack!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Toy Pack Unlocked", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of the sign-in screen layout within onboarding.
Adds interactive pet preview to friend selection without changing screen functionality or base rules.
Adds a new post-waiting verification step inside onboarding while keeping all required steps.
Redesigns the home intro onboarding screen into a control tutorial.
Reorders sign-in step to after adoption while maintaining all required onboarding steps.
Adds quality guidance hints to photo upload screen.
Adds progress updates and tip carousel to the waiting screen.
Redesigns path selection to a grid offering both preset adoptable pets and custom pet creation.
Adds fallback sign-in helper hints on the sign-in screen.
Onboarding copy mentions unlocked free extras/gifts.
